|-|Trivia=
*The achievements for the difficulty achievements are the first to be added before the update containing the achievements' content, as well as the first to have fewer teasers than released achievements.
*'''His Beard Was as White as Coke''' is a reference to the play ''{{w|Hamlet|The Tragedy of Hamlet, Prince of Denmark}}'' by {{w|William Shakespeare}}, specifically a line in [http://nfs.sparknotes.com/hamlet/page_250.html Act 4, Scene 5].
*''';)''' is an often used reply on the Steam forums by Overkill employee Almir, who portrays and voices the pilot in [[White Xmas]].
*'''Dance Dance GenSec''' may be a reference to either {{w|Dance, Dance (Fall Out Boy song)|the song by Fall Out Boy}}, {{w|Dance, Dance (Booty Luv song)|the song by Booty Luv}}, or the video game series ''{{w|Dance Dance Revolution}}''.
*'''I Know What I Like''' is from [[Art Gallery]]'s briefing screen.
*'''All About the Green''' is a reference to the song of the same name used in the musical ''{{w|The Wedding Singer (musical)|The Wedding Singer}}''.
*'''Gold Rush''' is a reference to the {{w|California Gold Rush}}.
*'''Fort Knoxed Down''' is a pun on "knocked down" and {{w|Fort Knox}}, in which is the {{w|United States Bullion Depository}}.
*'''Blood is Thicker Than Murkywater''' is a reference to the saying "{{w|blood is thicker than water}}".
*'''Mile High Club''' refers to the {{w|Mile high club|sexual slang}}.
*'''This is WAR Baby!''' is part of a quote from [[Jimmy]], who contracts the [[Boiling Point]] heist.
*'''What Are You Sinking About''' is a reference to a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yR0lWICH3rY German commercial about learning English].
*'''I Cut Down Trees, I Skip and Jump''' is a line from {{w|the Lumberjack Song}} by the {{w|Monty Python}} group.
*'''Long Gone''' may be a reference to [[#Spring Break Event|one of the achievements]] released with the [[Car Shop]] heist, which in turn references the film ''{{w|Gone in 60 Seconds (1974 film)|Gone in 60 Seconds}}'' and its {{w|Gone in 60 Seconds (2000 film)|2000 remake}}.
*'''In the Name of Heisenberg''' is a reference to the TV show ''{{w|Breaking Bad}}'' and its main protagonist {{w|Walter White (Breaking Bad)|Walter White}}, who goes by the alias "Heisenberg".
*'''Bag Throwing Simulator''' is a humorous nickname for ''[[PAYDAY 2]]''. On high difficulties, completion of the [[Diamond Store]] heist involves securing many loot bags.
*'''4 More Years''' references the duration a president stays in office in the United States once elected, "more" meaning being re-elected.
*'''Just Walk Straight Into The Bank''' is a quote from [[Bain]] in both the [[First World Bank|original First World Bank]] and the [[First World Bank (Payday 2)|remake]].
*'''First World Problems''' is a reference to a [http://knowyourmeme.com/memes/first-world-problems meme].
*'''What a Flat!''' is a quote from [[Bain]] in Day 3 of [[Framing Frame]].
*The achievements for completing [[GO Bank]] on the Mayhem and Death Sentence: One Down difficulties were originally named '''Rush B''' and '''I Would Like to Move My Money to a Bank That Doesn't Get Robbed''' respectively. The Death Sentence: One Down achievement was renamed and the old name moved to the Mayhem achievement in a later update, because there also was a [[Side Jobs# Potential Daily Safe House Challenges|Side Job]] called Rush B.
*'''I Would Like to Move My Money to a Bank That Doesn't Get Robbed''' is part of a phone call that can be heard in the [[GO Bank]] heist in stealth.
*'''The Global Elite''' is the highest rank in the [[w:c:counterstrike:Competitive|Competitive mode]] in ''{{w|Counter-Strike: Global Offensive}}''.
*'''There is no Goat Level''' is a reference to the {{w|Diablo (series)|''Diablo'' video game series}} and its developers, {{w|Blizzard Entertainment}}, insisting that [[w:c:diablo:The Secret Cow Level|there is no cow level]].
*'''You Goat to be Kidding Me...''' is a pun on "you got to be kidding me".
*'''Let the Chips Fall''' is part of the saying "let the chips fall where they may".
*'''Ocean's Four''' is a reference to the ''{{w|Ocean's Trilogy}}'' of films.
*'''Well in Russia Asshole Facks You!''' is part of a quote from [[Minor characters (Payday 2)#The Commissar|the Commissar]] in Day 1 of [[Hotline Miami]].
*'''Dennis' Menace''' is a reference to either the British comic strip ''{{w|Dennis the Menace and Gnasher}}'' or the American comic strip ''{{w|Dennis the Menace (U.S. comics)|Dennis the Menace}}'', as well as the [[w:c:hotlinemiami:Dennis Mask|mask]] in ''{{w|Hotline Miami}}''.
*'''Still Got That Lucky Dollar?''' is a reference to the dollar [[Hoxton]] picks up in the [[Hoxton Breakout]] trailer.
*'''I Survived Lab Rats with One Down And All I Got Was This Achievement''' is a reference to the trope [http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/AndAllIGotWasThisLousyTShirt And All I Got Was This Lousy T-Shirt].
*'''A $2000 Sports Car''' is a reference to the [[Vehicles#Falcogini|Falcogini]] in [[Mallcrasher|the level]] that's supposed to grant $2,000 in property damage when destroyed, however due to bugs, it grants $6,000 in property damage in-game instead.
*'''I'll Break Your Malls''' is a pun on "I'll break your balls".
*'''Now is the Nuclear Winter of Our Discontent''' is a reference to the play ''{{w|Richard III (play)|Richard III}}'' by {{w|William Shakespeare}}, specifically its first line.
*'''Dr. Strangevlad''' is a reference to the 1964 film ''{{w|Dr. Strangelove|Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb}}''.
*'''This Was Easier in the Tutorial...''' refers to the tutorial heist [[Get the Coke]], the first day of which is based on [[Nightclub]].
*'''My Chemical Brothers''' is a reference to both the American rock band {{w|My Chemical Romance}}, and the English electronic duo {{w|The Chemical Brothers}}.
*'''SIX DOZERS CHARGING''' is a reference to the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zjnJk5V9nSM Official 2014 PAYDAY Xmas Carol "12 Days of Xmas"], which in turn is a parody of {{w|The Twelve Days of Christmas (song)|the Twelve Days of Christmas}} {{w|Christmas carol}}. '''On my Twelfth Try with One Down, The True Pain Began''' also references the carol.
*'''Like Taking Candy From a Heavily Armed Military Force''' is a reference to the saying "like taking candy from a baby".
*'''Day at the Museum''' is a reference to the {{w|Night at the Museum (film series)|''Night at the Museum'' film series}}.
*'''The Jonssonligan''' is a reference to the {{w|Jönssonligan|fictional Swedish gang and its film series}}. It being attributed to [[The Diamond]] heist points to it being a reference to the film ''{{w|Jönssonligan och den svarta diamanten}}'' ("The Johnson Gang & the Black Diamond") in particular.
*'''Why Did The Heister Cross The Road?''' is a reference to the riddle "{{w|Why did the chicken cross the road?}}".
*'''Bright Lights, Broken City''' is a reference to either the song {{w|Bright Lights, Big City (song)|Bright Lights, Big City}}, the {{w|Bright Lights, Big City (novel)|novel named after the song}}, or the {{w|Bright Lights, Big City (film)|film based on the novel}}.
*'''A Steel Container of Professional Badasses''' is from [[Transport|Transport: Harbor]]'s briefing screen.
*'''Fog This Shit I'm Out!''' is a pun on "fuck this shit, I'm out!".
*'''Dmitri, Dearest of All My Friends!''' is a reference to a quote from the character [[w:c:maxpayne:Vladimir Lem|Vladimir Lem]] from the ''{{w|Max Payne (series)|Max Payne}}'' series of games.
*'''Death and Taxes''' is a reference to the poster tagline of [[Undercover|the original Undercover]], which in turn references a {{w|Death and taxes (idiom)|quote}} by {{w|Benjamin Franklin}}.
*'''A Sad Vlad is Bad''' is a quote from [[Vlad]] in [[White Xmas]].
*'''A Heister of Legend''' was named '''One more down, No more to go''' before Update #173, where the name was given to [[Masks (Payday 2)#One Down|the new mask]].
